clinical.quoteLong: I tried to fix it myself with nail clippers and, in hindsight, that was the mistake. Now it's angry and I can't get a shoe on.
clinical.presentationShort: 45yo F — 5 days painful ingrown great toenail with local redness. No spreading cellulitis, no fever, not diabetic.
clinical.presentationLong: 45-year-old female with five days of a painful ingrown great toenail with local redness, no spreading cellulitis and no fever.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → digital block and partial nail avulsion, dressing, footwear advice
diagnosis.why: One procedure, one resource — a textbook ESI 4. Always check for diabetes or vascular disease, which would change the whole picture; she has neither.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 45-year-old woman in casual clothes with one shoe off and a bare foot, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with one leg crossed over the other knee, holding the bare foot up to look at the toe. Expression: mildly annoyed and self-conscious. Clearly visible: one big toe red and swollen along the nail edge; one shoe off on the floor. Overall: entirely well, sore toe. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
